第99章 我把方向，他们干活-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

傍晚，赵志军回来了，三轮车上坐着个老头。

六十来岁，黑瘦黑瘦的，脸上的褶子像核桃壳。

穿着一件洗得发白的蓝布棉袄，手里攥着根旱烟袋。

正是老孙头。

“林老板，听说你包了村东头那片鱼塘？”

“孙大爷，您坐。”林国强给他搬了把椅子，倒了碗茶。

老孙头坐下来，捧着茶碗：“那片塘我熟，以前生产队的时候，我在那儿养过六年鱼。

后来分田到户，没人管了，就荒了。

那片塘底子好，北边有水渠，常年不断水。

塘底淤泥厚，肥得很，养草鱼、鲢鱼、鲤鱼都行。”

林国强一听，心里更有底了：“孙大爷，我想请您帮我管这片鱼塘。

一个月三十块工钱，管吃住，您看咋样？”

老孙头端着茶碗的手抖了一下：“三十块？”

“嗯。”

老孙头低下头，喝了一大口茶。

他种一年地，刨去种子肥料，落不下几个钱。

三十块一个月，一年三百六。

比他种地赚得多多了。

“林老板，我干。”

“那咱明天就去鱼塘看看，合计合计怎么弄。”

老孙头使劲点头。

晚饭留老孙头在店里吃的。

红烧肉、炒鸡蛋、白菜炖粉条，老孙头吃了三大碗米饭。

放下碗筷的时候，他抹了抹嘴，一脸的满足。

“林老板，你放心，那片塘交给我，我给你养得鱼肥藕壮。”

林国强给他添了碗茶：“孙大爷，我信您。”

夜里，林国强躺在炕上，把承包合同又看了一遍。

赵素梅靠过来，就着灯光看了看。

“国强，鱼塘、大棚、菜地、饭店……你一个人管得过来吗？”

“管得过来，鱼塘有孙大爷，菜地有张老四和爹盯着，大棚我自己管，店里有志军。

我把方向，他们干活。”

赵素梅想了想，确实是这个理。

窗外起了风，吹得枣树枝丫哗哗响。

林庆安在炕那头翻了个身，哼唧了两声，又睡过去了。

In the evening, Zhao Zhijun came back and there was an old man sitting on the tricycle.

He is in his sixties, dark and thin, with wrinkles on his face like walnut shells.

He was wearing a blue cotton-padded jacket that had been washed white, and he was holding a dry cigarette pouch in his hand.

It was Lao Suntou.

"Boss Lin, I heard that you own the fish pond at the east end of the village?"

"Uncle Sun, please sit down." Lin Guoqiang moved a chair for him and poured a bowl of tea.

Old Suntou sat down and held a tea bowl: "I know that pond well. I raised fish there for six years when I was on the production team.

Later, the fields were divided among households and no one took care of them, so they became deserted.

The pond has a good foundation, and there is a canal on the north side, which keeps the water flowing all year round.

The silt at the bottom of the pond is thick and very fat, and it is suitable for raising grass carp, silver carp, and carp."

When Lin Guoqiang heard this, he felt more confident: "Uncle Sun, I would like to ask you to help me manage this fish pond.

Thirty yuan a month, including food and accommodation, what do you think?"

Lao Sun's hand holding the tea bowl shook: "Thirty yuan?"

"Yeah."

Old Sun lowered his head and took a big sip of tea.

He cultivated the land for a year, plowed away the seeds and fertilizers, and could not save a few cents.

Thirty yuan a month, three hundred and sixty a year.

He earns much more than he does from farming.

"Boss Lin, I'll do it."

"Then let's go to the fish pond tomorrow to see how we can get the total."

Lao Suntou nodded vigorously.

I left Lao Suntou to eat dinner in the store.

Braised pork, scrambled eggs, and cabbage stewed with vermicelli, Lao Suntou ate three large bowls of rice.

When he put down the bowl and chopsticks, he wiped his mouth with a satisfied look on his face.

"Boss Lin, don't worry, leave that pond to me and I'll make the fish fat and healthy for you."

Lin Guoqiang gave him a bowl of tea: "Uncle Sun, I believe in you."

At night, Lin Guoqiang lay on the kang and read the contract again.

Zhao Sumei came over and looked at it under the light.

"Guoqiang, can you manage the fish ponds, greenhouses, vegetable fields, restaurants... by yourself?"

"I can take care of it. Uncle Sun is in charge of the fish pond, Zhang Laosi and Dad are watching over the vegetable field, I am in charge of the greenhouse myself, and Zhijun is in charge of the store.

I pointed the direction and they worked."

Zhao Sumei thought about it and realized that this was indeed the case.

The wind picked up outside the window, making the jujube branches rustle.

Lin Qing'an turned over on the other end of the kang, snorted twice, and fell asleep again.
